title: @ycforge/js-dev-tools — local dev server contract (spec 023)
description: Machine-readable contract for createYcsfLocalServer (spec 023, S-1..S-3, FR-001..004, FR-029). Public surface of the @ycforge/js-dev-tools/server subpath. Fail-fast on configuration via JDT_* diagnostic codes (Constitution V, D-8/D-10). Event/context/response shapes are connector contracts (@ycforge/nestjs-connector RawHttpApiGatewayV2Event / YandexFunctionHttpResponse) and are not re-contracted here.

yandexContext.title: yandexContext
yandexContext.description: Input data for raw runtime-context synthesis (S-6, FR-016..018). Optional fields; unknown extra fields are merged over deterministic defaults (explicit override escape hatch).

token.description: IAM token for @YandexContext().token. Secret: never logged, never echoed in banners/responses (FR-017, FR-028). When absent the raw context has no token key.

folderId.description: Becomes functionFolderId in the raw context (FR-018).

cloudId.description: Becomes cloudId in the raw context, readable via @YandexContext().raw escape hatch; no normalized typed field exists (Q-2, FR-018).

ycsfLocalServerOptions.title: YcsfLocalServerOptions
ycsfLocalServerOptions.description: Options of createYcsfLocalServer (S-2, FR-002). All optional except entry.

entry.description: Path to a module exporting the root NestJS module (relative resolved from cwd, or absolute). Loaded via host dynamic import without transpilation (S-3, FR-005).

apiGatewayV2.description: Enable HTTP / API Gateway v2 (payload 2.0) emulation.

messageQueue.description: Message Queue trigger emulation. true → fail-fast JDT_MQ_UNSUPPORTED (out of v1, D-8).

port.description: TCP port for the HTTP server. 0 → OS-assigned (tests). Bind host fixed to 127.0.0.1 (A-3).

localDevServer.title: LocalDevServer
localDevServer.description: Handle returned by createYcsfLocalServer (S-2, FR-003). Promise resolves after the HTTP server actually listens.

port.description: Actual bound port (after listen; for port:0 the OS-assigned value).

stop.description: stop(): Promise<void> — idempotent; closes the HTTP listener and calls the connector handler close() (FR-009).

jdtDiagnosticCode.title: JdtDiagnosticCode
jdtDiagnosticCode.description: Diagnostic code family JDT_* (FR-029). Startup failures reject the returned promise with a LocalDevServerError carrying these codes; JDT_IAM_UNAVAILABLE is a warning, not a rejection (fail-open, D-10). JDT_INVALID_PORT is a documented additive code beyond the closed FR-029 catalog (port is a mandatory fail-fast configuration surface, S-2), raised by option validation before probe/bind.

localDevServerError.title: LocalDevServerError
localDevServerError.description: Rejection shape: Error subclass with .code and optional .cause.

cause.description: Original error (import failure, kernel EADDRINUSE, etc.); may be absent.

failFastConditions.title: Fail-fast conditions (FR-004, S-2)
failFastConditions.description: None of these raises a listener or creates a connector handler.

JDT_MQ_UNSUPPORTED.description: messageQueue: true → rejected before any side effect (D-8).

JDT_PORT_IN_USE.description: Port already bound (EADDRINUSE) → rejected with the port in the message.

JDT_INVALID_PORT.description: port is not an integer in [0, 65535] → rejected before any probe/bind (additive code, S-2 option validation; see parent description).

JDT_ENTRY_RESOLVE_FAILED.description: entry file missing or dynamic import threw (incl. unhandled TS extension under a plain Node host) → rejected.

JDT_ENTRY_MODULE_NOT_FOUND.description: No AppModule named export and no default export → rejected, message lists allowed exports (S-3, FR-006).

JDT_ENTRY_MODULE_AMBIGUOUS.description: Both AppModule named export and a different class as default export → rejected (no guessing, FR-006).

observability.title: Observability (S-9, FR-026..028)
observability.description: Startup banner and per-request log to stderr. Token value never appears (FR-028).

startupBanner.description: Contains URL, mode, IAM status; never the token value.

iamWarning.description: Warning emitted once per start when token resolution failed (fail-open).

createYcsfLocalServer.title: createYcsfLocalServer
createYcsfLocalServer.description: Entry contract (S-2, FR-003): createYcsfLocalServer(options) → Promise<LocalDevServer>; resolves after bind, rejects with LocalDevServerError on any startup error (fail-fast) — except IAM which fails open with a warning.
